data.purpose: Detect fraudulent card transactions using a logistic regression model.
data.scope_and_use: The model is intended for use in identifying potentially fraudulent transactions in real-time, supporting decisions based on the output of the logistic model.
data.data: The model uses the Kaggle dataset 'Credit Card Fraud Detection' (ULB), which requires manual download and is not stored in the repository. The primary input file is 'creditcard.csv'.
data.methodology: The model employs a Generalized Linear Model (GLM) with a binomial family to predict the likelihood of fraud based on selected features.
data.variables: The model utilizes the following features: V1, V3, V4, V10, V12, V14, V17, and logamt.
data.implementation: The model is implemented in R, with the entry script named 'fr001_fraud.R'. It is deployable and operates as a binary classification task with a decision threshold set at 0.5.
data.assumptions_limitations: The model assumes that the features selected are sufficient to capture the patterns of fraudulent transactions. Limitations include reliance on the quality and representativeness of the training data.
data.gaps: Performance and monitoring details are not documented. Governance structure and processes are not documented.
